response.text:
I can’t run work in the background or message you later unless a real automation/reminder tool is connected and confirmed. I don’t have the ability to continue working after this turn or to initiate outbound messages on my own.

Options I can do right now (pick one or more):
- Do the work now in this session — tell me the task, deliverables, and any constraints; I’ll complete as much as possible here and tell you what remains.
- Prepare everything now plus a "finished" message you can send later (email, Slack, SMS template), and a short checklist of next steps.
- Help you create a calendar event or reminder (I’ll give exact steps for Google Calendar/Outlook/phone) so you’ll be notified when I’d be finished.
- If you have a connected automation (calendar, email, Slack) and want me to use it, tell me which and confirm access — then I can schedule/send on your behalf.

Tell me: what exactly is "this"? (task details, target deliverable, deadline, and whether you want a reminder or a finished-message template). I’ll proceed immediately.
